summary: Iter91 verifies the kiosk WS backend after removal of the chat functions and the startup drop of kiosk_chat. Added /app/backend/tests/test_iter91_kiosk_ws_no_chat.py (5 tests, 5 passing): (1) kiosk_chat collection no longer exists, (2) employee WS auth+device_config+ping+legacy chat_send/chat_history silently ignored, (3) admin WS receives device_config+presence with employees/printers and survives garbage/non-JSON messages, presence_changed on emp connect/BYE, (4) PRINT_RECEIPT from employee creates kiosk_print_log and reaches admin, (5) remote print flow: printer WS + POST /api/kiosk/print-log/by-payment/{id}/remote-print -> REMOTE_PRINT to printer, REMOTE_PRINT_DONE forwarded to admin. Frontend smoke: admin logged in demo@surirent.sr, Open Kiosk opens /my-awesome-rentals-bv/kiosk; testids present are kiosk-root, kiosk-toolbar, kiosk-presence-dot, locations, kiosk-mobile-fab, kiosk-bottom-bar, kiosk-footer-company, kiosk-add-*-btn-desktop, kiosk-payments-viewer-btn-desktop, kiosk-admin-btn-desktop, kiosk-kasgeld-btn-desktop, kiosk-lock-btn-desktop — NO chat testids anywhere. Only console error is one benign 401 from an unauth probe during initial load.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py startup drops kiosk_chat (idempotent, wrapped in try/except) — clean.
_kiosk_ws_employee: unknown message kinds (including legacy chat_send/chat_history) fall through silently without closing — matches the Dutch user's intent.
_kiosk_ws_admin.receive() uses await ws.receive_text() in a bare loop which accepts arbitrary text/binary without reacting — kiosk connection is now lighter as requested.

Admin WS still requires BOTH a kiosk `token` AND `admin_token` in the hello frame (_ws_company). Frontend already sends both; just worth noting for next test iteration (test uses the kiosk-pin token for admin hello).

success_rate.frontend: 100% smoke (no chat UI, kiosk loads clean)
